title: Concept: Central package version declared as a wildcard
description: Directory.Packages.props declares a `<PackageVersion>` value of `*`, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a `<PackageVersion>` value of `*`.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Directory.Packages.props (nuget).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a `<PackageVersion>` value of `*`.
